result.Method of Attack: Malicious setuptools install hook using cmdclass to execute code during installation on macOS systems; Targeted execution based on system UUID gathered via ioreg command; Steganography by appending a malicious Go binary to a large PNG file (requests-sidebar-large.png); Extraction of hidden binary from image, making it executable and running it silently; Use of OSX/Sliver C2 framework malware embedded in the binary
result.Attack Vector: Installation of malicious PyPI package with customized install command; Execution of hidden payload during package installation on targeted macOS machines
result.Indicators of Compromise: Package name: requests-darwin-lite; Malicious base64 decoded command: ioreg -d2 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice; Target UUID: 08383A8F-DA4B-5783-A262-4DDC93169C52; Large PNG file: docs/_static/requests-sidebar-large.png (~17MB); Use of subprocess.Popen with output suppressed (stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL); References to OSX/Sliver malware detected by VirusTotal; PyPI repository taken down after reporting
